title: Five
summary: 离线五子棋，支持 Rapfi 人机和同机双人。 Offline Gomoku with Rapfi or local two-player.
description:
简体中文
在 Cardputer Zero 上离线下五子棋。可与 Rapfi 对弈，选择简单、普通或困难，也可在同一台设备上双人对弈。支持 15×15 和 13×13 棋盘、自由规则和连珠禁手。设置中可查看规则说明，两种对局均支持悔棋和续局。界面支持简体中文和英文。

Five 应用部分采用专有许可。Rapfi 是独立引擎，按 GPL-3.0-or-later 分发，官方模型权重采用 CC0-1.0。安装包内的 /usr/share/doc/five/ 提供 Rapfi 对应源码、构建脚本及许可证。

English
Play offline Gomoku on Cardputer Zero. Play Rapfi at three difficulty levels or share one device with a friend. Choose a 15×15 or 13×13 board and Freestyle or Renju fouls. A rules guide, undo and resume are available. The interface supports Simplified Chinese and English.

Five is proprietary. The separate Rapfi engine is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later and its official weights under CC0-1.0. Corresponding Rapfi source, build instructions and license texts are included in the package under /usr/share/doc/five/.
